resumeText: Yasmine Benali is an LLM / GenAI Engineer at Voxalia AI with five years of experience. She designs production-grade applications on OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, iterating on prompts and grounding output with RAG patterns over vector databases. She built and owns the vector indexing strategy for a customer-facing support assistant, and previously productionized PyTorch models at Meridian Analytics. Her work spans the full LLM lifecycle from prompt design to retrieval evaluation.
